name: GR:ONE frameset

editorial.verdict: A polished gravel-race near-miss: relatively light and fast-looking, but limited to 45 mm and longer than a literal road-race chassis.
caveats: Size M uses 425 mm chainstays and a 1,032 mm wheelbase

purchase_route: Current Quick Pro global storefront sells the exact GR:ONE frame for US$2,099 with Add to cart and current delivery guidance; the China product page remains another direct route. Confirm mainland CNY checkout, customization, tax and warranty handling.
